title: The stream of experience is a series of SOHM formations

statements.text: The stream of experience is a series of SOHM-formation events, each computing a joint posterior or a maximal estimate over the sensorium of an embodied agent, so that each quale state constrains the next.

sources.quote: IWMT further suggests that the stream of experience (Figure 1) is constituted by a series of SOHM-formation events
each quale state would functionally connect and constrain future quale states based on past quale states
